newsitem.title: USA: Amerihost results up on hotel development.
newsitem.headline: Amerihost results up on hotel development.

text.p: Amerihost Properties Inc said Friday it reported strong 1996 results as a result of hotel development and growth in hotel operations.
Earlier, Amerihost reported fourth quarter net earnings of $135,566 compared with $13,536 last year. Earnings for the year were $3.39 million versus $2.14 million.
The company said as of December 31, 38 AmeriHost Inn hotels were open and 19 were under contruction, compared to 14 abd 16 at December 31, 1995.
For 1996, same room sales for AmeriHost Inn hotels were up 14.5 percent, same room average daily rates rose $1.71 and occupancy increased 10.7 percent.

"We continue to see favorable results with the seasoned AmeriHost Inn hotels," Michael Holtz, president and chief executive of AmeriHost said. "In addition, a significant number of new AmeriHost Inn hotels were operating in 1996 during the initial stabilization period inherent with new hotels. As the new hotels mature, we expect the company to realize significant benefits."
On Thursday, Amerihost said it is in the process of evaluating proposals for the acquisition of its outstanding common stock, but no agreement had been reached.
